international_aviation.headline: 波特航空班機因幼童站立返門 延誤超過宵禁遭取消
international_aviation.summary: 根據 Simple Flying 報導，波特航空（Porter Airlines）一班深夜航班因機組人員無法成功安頓一名在座位上站立的幼童，導致飛機被迫返回登機門。該班航班隨後因作業延誤時間超過機場宵禁規定而宣告取消，造成機上所有人員被迫滯留過夜。
international_aviation.headline_en: Porter Airlines Cancels Flight After Toddler Stands in Seat and Delays It Past Curfew
international_aviation.summary_en: According to a report from Simple Flying, a late-night Porter Airlines flight was forced to return to the airport gate before departure after the cabin crew was unable to properly secure a young toddler standing on a seat. As a direct result of the delay caused by the seat incident, the departure missed its scheduled window and pushed past the local airport's overnight curfew rules, forcing the airline to cancel the flight and leaving all onboard passengers stranded overnight.

international_aviation.headline: 空中巴士7月交付67架新機 受到發動機短缺與供應鏈干擾
international_aviation.summary: 根據Simple Flying報導，空中巴士於2026年7月交付67架新飛機，交機數量低於達成年度目標所需的月平均水準。受限於供應鏈瓶頸與發動機短缺問題，空中巴士生產進度持續受到挑戰，相關團隊正全力清理積壓的訂單，並維持全年交付870架飛機的目標。
international_aviation.headline_en: Airbus Delivers 67 Aircraft in July Amid Supply Chain and Engine Shortages
international_aviation.summary_en: According to Simple Flying, Airbus delivered 67 new aircraft in July 2026, remaining below the monthly delivery average required to achieve its annual targets. Production operations continue to be stretched by supply chain disruption and engine shortages, as assembly teams work to process a growing backlog of unfulfilled aircraft orders. Historically, Airbus achieved 237 deliveries during the second quarter and has maintained its target of delivering 870 aircraft for the full year.

international_aviation.headline: 墨爾本機場空中巴士A380航班數增32%
international_aviation.summary: 根據 Simple Flying 報導，墨爾本機場空中巴士 A380 航班量將增加 32%。在 11 月至 3 月期間，墨爾本機場預計增加 109 個 A380 起飛航班，主因為有航空公司重新導入重型廣體客機運力。歷史紀錄顯示，澳洲航空先前曾規劃於 10 月 24 日結束墨爾本至洛杉磯的 A380 航線並改用波音 787-9。
international_aviation.headline_en: Melbourne Airport Sees 32% Increase in Airbus A380 Flights
international_aviation.summary_en: According to a report by Simple Flying, Melbourne Airport is experiencing a 32% increase in Airbus A380 flights. The Australian airport will handle 109 extra superjumbo departures scheduled between November and March. This spike in superjumbo flight activity occurs as one carrier reintroduces heavy widebody aircraft capacity. Meanwhile, historical records note that Qantas previously scheduled its final Airbus A380 service between Melbourne and Los Angeles for October 24, choosing to utilize the Boeing 787-9 widebody aircraft instead.
